user.title: Add a Wi-Fi camera
user.description: Paste the camera's streaming link (RTSP, RTMP, HLS .m3u8 or HTTP MJPEG). Example: rtsp://192.168.1.50:554/stream1

data_description.stream_url: The live video link. Credentials can be in the URL or entered below.
data_description.snapshot_url: An http(s) link that returns a JPEG. Faster thumbnails; leave empty to grab frames from the stream.
data_description.rtsp_transport: TCP is the most reliable for Wi-Fi cameras.

error.invalid_url: The stream URL must start with rtsp://, rtsps://, rtmp://, http:// or https://
error.invalid_snapshot_url: The snapshot URL must start with http:// or https://
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't read a frame from the stream. Check the URL, credentials and that the camera is reachable from Home Assistant.
